dropped.item: "and other health markers": bloodwork screens more than kidneys, liver, and blood sugar
"make the most of their yearly checkup": the framing of the panel as adding value to the annual visit

changed.item: "should include more than vaccines" (a recommendation) became "is about more than shots" (a description), which weakens the advice
"Bloodwork can help spot changes" became "Bloodwork can catch changes", which slightly overstates certainty
"a fuller picture of your dog's health" became "the full picture", which overstates what the panel provides
"Annual testing" became "It" (bloodwork), so the emphasis on repeating the test every year is now only implied by "year after year"

added.item: "at their next visit" adds a time framing that suggests getting the panel at the upcoming appointment
